description: This file implements a notifier component for handling block change notifications in a collaborative workspace, including managing notification hints, subscriber notifications, and diff generation.

classes.name: notifier
classes.description: A struct that manages block change notifications, including hint processing, subscriber notification, and diff generation.

methods.name: newNotifier
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new notifier instance with specified backend parameters.

methods.name: notifier.start
methods.description: Starts the notification loop if not already running.

methods.name: notifier.stop
methods.description: Stops the notification loop if it is running.

methods.name: notifier.onNotifyHint
methods.description: Enqueues a notification hint for processing.

methods.name: notifier.notify
methods.description: Fetches the next notification hint and triggers subscriber notifications.

methods.name: notifier.notifySubscribers
methods.description: Generates diffs and sends notifications to subscribers for a given hint.
